name: Scroll 360 Turntable
description: A pinned hero where a product spins a full 360 degrees as you scroll, with a layered headline that fades and letter-spaces out. Ships a CSS-3D faceted bottle by default plus a frame-sequence mode for real 360 photo shoots.
usage: Copy the .turntable-section markup from index.html, include styles.css, load GSAP plus ScrollTrigger, then call initTurntable(). For a real 360 shoot call initTurntable({ frames: [urls] }) and the scrub swaps preloaded frames instead of rotating the CSS object.
source: Pattern seen on https://coffee-tech.com (Awwwards SOTD by MAKETHECUT and Or Halevi), implemented from scratch
